reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Short title as Uniform Disposition of Unclaimed Property Act
headings.reviewNote: Cites sections 447.500 to 447.595 as the Uniform Disposition of Unclaimed Property Act.

headings.title: Statutory construction to effectuate uniformity among states
headings.reviewNote: Mandates construction of sections 447.500 to 447.595 to effectuate uniform law among enacting states, subject to nonconforming text exceptions.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (7-01-94); verified short title and uniform construction rule with nonconforming-text exception.

headings.title: Authorized charges and prior customer notice requirements
headings.reviewNote: Permits banking, business, or financial organizations to impose lawful charges including CD prepayment penalties on unclaimed property upon prior notice.

headings.title: Bona fide computation errors and recredited customer charges
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that bona fide computation errors resulting in recredited charges do not establish a pattern of custom or usage for unclaimed property charges.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1989 H.B. 506, A.L. 1994 S.B. 757, A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified lawful CD/property charges with prior notice and bona fide recredited error rule.

headings.title: Presumption of abandonment for unclaimed insurance funds
headings.reviewNote: Establishes presumption of abandonment for unclaimed insurance funds when the entitled person's last known address is in Missouri.

headings.title: Definition of unclaimed funds and policy maturity rules
headings.reviewNote: Defines unclaimed funds under insurance policies or annuity contracts and specifies limiting age maturity rules and qualifying owner communications.

headings.title: Presumed abandonment of demutualization or reorganization distributions
headings.reviewNote: Governs abandonment of property distributable during insurance company demutualization, rehabilitation, or reorganization and sets reporting deadlines.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2003 S.B. 346); verified insurance abandonment presumption, settlement-offer draft exception, limiting-age maturity rule, and demutualization reporting dates.

headings.title: Presumed abandoned utility deposits and service refunds
headings.reviewNote: Presumes abandonment for unclaimed subscriber deposits and advance payments held by utilities after statutory dormancy periods.

headings.title: Post-1984 applicability for Rural Electrification Act loan recipients
headings.reviewNote: Limits sections 447.500 to 447.595 for chapter 274, 357, 394, and chapter 351 electric service corporations receiving Rural Electrification Act of 1936 loans to property/funds whose dormancy period began after August 13, 1984.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); replaced incorrect subsection 2 title and note (draft wrongly described a patronage-capital exemption; text limits post-August 13, 1984 applicability for Rural Electrification Act loan-recipient corporations).

headings.title: Presumed abandoned stock, dividends, and association distributions
headings.reviewNote: Presumes abandonment for stock certificates, dividends, profits, or principal distributions held by business associations after statutory dormancy.

headings.title: Presumed abandoned intangible ownership interests in business associations
headings.reviewNote: Presumes abandonment of intangible ownership interests evidenced by stock or membership records when uncontacted and unclaimed for statutory dormancy periods.

headings.title: Simultaneous abandonment of attached dividends and distributions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that dividends or distributions attachable to abandoned stock or securities are considered abandoned at the same time.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1984 H.B. 1088 § 5, A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified business association stock, intangible ownership interest, and attached dividend abandonment rules.

headings.title: Intangible property held by Missouri courts and public officers
headings.reviewNote: Presumes abandoned intangible personal property held for over three years by Missouri courts, receiverships, or public officers as of June 19, 2002.

headings.title: Intangible property held by federal or out-of-state public entities
headings.reviewNote: Deems abandoned three-year unclaimed property held by public entities of the United States, states, or local governments, with last known Missouri address rules.

headings.title: Applicability of unclaimed property provisions to public holdings
headings.reviewNote: Subjects all intangible personal property held by public entities to sections 447.500 to 447.595.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (6-19-02); verified three-year abandonment rules for Missouri, federal, and out-of-state courts and public entities.

headings.title: Presumed abandoned intangible property with unknown owner address
headings.reviewNote: Presumes abandoned intangible property with unknown owner address where the originating or issuing entity is Missouri or organized in the state.

headings.title: Nonapplicability to property with different statutory dormancy periods
headings.reviewNote: Excludes property governed by other statutory provisions prescribing a different dormancy period from subsection 1.

headings.title: Applicability to property held on or after August 28, 1990
headings.reviewNote: Applies subsection 1 rules to all property held as of August 28, 1990, or thereafter, regardless of when dormancy commenced.

headings.title: Exemption for principal Missouri banking and financial organizations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts property held in Missouri by banking or financial organizations having their principal place of business in the state.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified unknown-address abandonment, different-dormancy exclusion, August 28, 1990 applicability, and principal Missouri bank/financial exemption.

headings.title: Presumed abandonment, escheat, and judicial proceedings for savings bonds
headings.reviewNote: Sets three-year maturity abandonment and escheat for unclaimed United States savings bonds and establishes Cole County circuit court proceedings.

headings.title: Claims for escheated savings bonds and proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes claims for escheated savings bonds or proceeds under section 447.562 and treasurer payment under section 447.565.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text, split 2014 effective dates, and H.B. 1693 original-rolls footnotes ('subsections' and 'section 1'); verified U.S. savings bond three-year escheat, Cole County action, and post-escheat claims.

headings.title: Presumed abandoned miscellaneous intangible personal property
headings.reviewNote: Presumes abandonment for miscellaneous intangible property held in ordinary course of business after statutory dormancy periods.

headings.title: Commercial transactions and ongoing business relationship exemption
headings.reviewNote: Exempts commercial remittances, checks, and balances between business entities having an ongoing business relationship within the dormancy period.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1075); verified residual intangible abandonment, shorter-dormancy jurisdiction acceptance, and ongoing business relationship commercial exemption.

headings.title: Annual report of abandoned property filed with state treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Requires persons holding presumed abandoned property to file an annual verified report with the state treasurer.

headings.title: Required information and itemization thresholds in holder report
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required report information, itemization thresholds for property of fifty dollars or more, and record retention limits.

headings.title: Reporting prior names and addresses of predecessor holders
headings.reviewNote: Requires successor holders or entities that changed names to report all prior known names and addresses of each holder.

headings.title: Filing deadlines and extension requests for annual reports
headings.reviewNote: Establishes November first annual filing deadline, May first deadline for life insurers, and thirty-day treasurer extension authority.

headings.title: Holder pre-reporting communication and diligence for property over fifty dollars
headings.reviewNote: Mandates holder due diligence and communication with known-whereabouts owners of property valued at fifty dollars or more prior to reporting.

headings.title: Execution of report verification by partners or corporate officers
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that report verification must be executed by a partner for partnerships, or by an officer for corporations and unincorporated associations.

headings.title: Penalty for holder failure to exercise reasonable diligence
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state treasurer to impose a penalty of up to twenty percent of property value for failure to exercise reasonable diligence.

headings.title: Assessment notice, reconsideration, interest, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Governs assessment due dates, reconsideration requests, interest accrual on unpaid assessments, waivers for good cause, and deposit into general revenue.

headings.title: Five-year record retention requirement after reporting property
headings.reviewNote: Requires holders to retain verification records for at least five years after reporting abandoned property to the treasurer.

headings.title: Treasurer estimation techniques and holder de novo judicial appeal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes treasurer estimation techniques in accordance with GAAP when records are lacking and provides de novo circuit court appeal rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified all ten subsections covering reporting, $50 thresholds, due diligence, 20% penalty, 1.5%/month interest, 5-year retention, GAAP estimation, and de novo appeal.

headings.title: Published notice requirements for reported abandoned property
headings.reviewNote: Directs treasurer to publish annual notice of abandoned property reports in qualified county newspapers within statutory timeframes.

headings.title: Notice contents, sale warning, and aggregate value threshold
headings.reviewNote: Specifies published notice contents, sale warning under section 447.558, and fifty-dollar aggregate threshold for published items.

headings.title: Mailed notice to apparent owners of property valued at fifty dollars or more
headings.reviewNote: Requires treasurer to mail notice within one hundred twenty days of report receipt to apparent owners of property valued at fifty dollars or more.

headings.title: Required statements and warnings in mailed notices to owners
headings.reviewNote: Mandates statements in mailed notices concerning held property and impending sale under section 447.558 if proof of claim is not presented.

headings.title: Inapplicability of notice requirements to traveler's checks and money orders
headings.reviewNote: Exempts sums payable on traveler's checks and money orders from published and mailed notice requirements under subsections 1 and 4.

headings.title: Interagency holder outreach and educational notice
headings.reviewNote: Directs treasurer to collaborate with other state agencies to inform holders of their rights and responsibilities under unclaimed property laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified publication and mailed notice deadlines, $50 aggregate threshold, traveler's check/money order exemption, and interagency holder outreach.

headings.title: Payment and delivery of abandoned property and holder compliance costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires holders to deliver reported property and moneys to treasurer, permitting retention of approved compliance costs or error explanations.

headings.title: Abandoned fund account administration, public records, and transfers
headings.reviewNote: Creates Abandoned Fund Account, governs public record access, restrictions on commercial locators, and transfers to general revenue.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified property delivery, approved compliance costs, Abandoned Fund Account, 90-day commercial locator restriction, and general-revenue transfer/restoration thresholds.

headings.title: State custody and relief of holder liability upon property delivery
headings.reviewNote: Relieves holders of liability for claims upon payment or delivery of abandoned property and places safekeeping responsibility on the state.

headings.title: Notice of legal proceedings against holder by another state
headings.reviewNote: Requires holders sued by other states for delivered property to notify the treasurer and attorney general, permitting state intervention.

headings.title: State reimbursement of judgments entered against prior holders
headings.reviewNote: Directs treasurer to return judgment amounts paid against prior holders up to the reported value of the disputed property upon proof.

headings.title: Delivery of duplicate stock certificates and transfer of underlying shares
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes delivery of duplicate certificates or transfer of title to underlying shares, relieving holders and transfer agents of liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified state custody and holder relief, interstate litigation notice/intervention, judgment reimbursement, and duplicate stock certificate delivery.

headings.title: Exclusion for property with title vested by limitations prior to August 13, 1984
headings.reviewNote: Excludes property with title vested by limitations prior to August 13, 1984, and pre-1974 fiduciary property, with governmental holder exception.

headings.title: Payment and delivery not barred by limitations absent prior vested title
headings.reviewNote: Provides that statutes of limitations do not bar delivery of unclaimed property unless title vested in the holder prior to August 13, 1984.

headings.title: Exemption for probate division distribution orders and decrees
headings.reviewNote: Exempts final probate division distribution orders, judgments, and decrees entered after August 13, 1984, from unclaimed property provisions.

headings.title: Exemption for Farm Credit Act chartered institutions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts institutions chartered under the federal Farm Credit Act of 1971 from sections 447.500 to 447.595.

headings.title: Exemption for pre-1965 unclaimed banking and financial organization property
headings.reviewNote: Excludes property unclaimed prior to January 1, 1965, held by banking or financial organizations with principal place of business in Missouri.

headings.title: Exemption for business-to-business credits
headings.reviewNote: Exempts business credits between two business entities or associations from sections 447.500 to 447.595.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1075); verified pre-August 13, 1984 vested-title exclusion (with government holder exception), probate decrees, Farm Credit Act institutions, pre-1965 bank property, and business-to-business credits.

headings.title: Three-year limitation on treasurer enforcement following report or dispute
headings.reviewNote: Bars treasurer enforcement more than three years after the holder filed a report or gave express notice of dispute.

headings.title: Six-year limitation on treasurer enforcement for fraudulent reports
headings.reviewNote: Permits treasurer enforcement within six years of filing where a fraudulent report was submitted with intent to evade escheatment.

headings.title: Enforcement at any time when no report filed
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes treasurer enforcement of chapter provisions at any time if no holder report was filed.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 2014 H.B. 1075); verified 3-year general enforcement limit, 6-year fraudulent report limit, and unlimited enforcement when no report is filed.

headings.title: Statutes of limitations unavailable as defense for governmental entities
headings.reviewNote: Bars governmental entities from asserting expiration of limitations periods as a defense against treasurer actions for abandoned property.

headings.title: Applicability to governmental abandoned property held on or after August 28, 1990
headings.reviewNote: Applies non-defense provisions to all abandoned property held by federal or state entities as of August 28, 1990, or thereafter.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (7-01-94); verified unavailability of statute-of-limitations defenses for federal/state entities and August 28, 1990 applicability.

headings.title: Public sale of abandoned property by treasurer within two years
headings.reviewNote: Requires treasurer to sell delivered abandoned property at public sale within two years, with bid rejection and sale cost exceptions.

headings.title: Published notice requirements for public sales
headings.reviewNote: Requires single publication of sale notice in qualified county newspapers at least three weeks before sale, excluding marketable securities.

headings.title: Title conveyed to purchaser free of prior claims
headings.reviewNote: Vests title in purchasers free of all prior claims and authorizes treasurer to execute transfer documents.

headings.title: Deposit of sale proceeds into abandoned funds account
headings.reviewNote: Mandates immediate deposit of abandoned property sale proceeds into the abandoned funds account.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified two-year public sale rule, three-week notice (excluding marketable securities), free-and-clear purchaser title, and deposit of proceeds.

headings.title: Public records of abandoned property owners and insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Directs treasurer to retain records of entitled persons and insurance policy details for public inspection during business hours.

headings.title: Confidentiality of holder reports and misdemeanor penalty for unauthorized disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Classifies identifying information in holder reports as confidential and makes unauthorized disclosure a misdemeanor.

headings.title: Public disclosure rules for abandoned property under fifty dollars
headings.reviewNote: Governs public availability of records for amounts under fifty dollars and restricts dissemination by third parties.

headings.title: Public disclosure of military medal information to identify owners or heirs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes public release of non-Social Security military medal information and visual depictions to locate owners or heirs.

headings.title: Public records of owners of escheated United States savings bonds
headings.reviewNote: Requires treasurer to retain public records of names and addresses on redeemed escheated U.S. savings bonds, allows public disclosure of redeemed amounts under $50, keeps other identifying data confidential, and makes unauthorized disclosure a misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and split 2014 effective dates; corrected subsection 5 reviewNote to remove non-statutory 'website publication' claim and reflect misdemeanor penalty for unauthorized disclosure.

headings.title: Treasurer consideration, hearings, and written decisions on claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires treasurer to consider claims, authorizes hearings, and mandates written public findings and decisions.

headings.title: Payment of allowed claims without deductions and interest
headings.reviewNote: Directs prompt payment of allowed claims without deduction for notice, sale, or service charges, including interest at treasurer annualized return rates capped at seven years after abandonment transfer.

headings.title: Discharge of treasurer liability upon payment of claim
headings.reviewNote: Discharges treasurer liability upon payment and makes payees accountable to persons with superior rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and original-rolls footnote ('treasure' in sub 3); refined subsection 2 title to clarify payment without fee/notice deductions.

headings.title: Administrative contested case hearing rights for aggrieved claimants
headings.reviewNote: Entitles claimants aggrieved by treasurer decisions or 90-day inaction to chapter 536 contested case hearings.

headings.title: Administrative contested case hearing rights for aggrieved reporting holders
headings.reviewNote: Entitles reporting holders aggrieved by treasurer decisions to chapter 536 contested case hearings.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2014 H.B. 1075); verified chapter 536 contested-case hearing rights for aggrieved claimants (including 90-day inaction) and reporting holders.

headings.title: Civil penalties for intentional failure to file reports or perform duties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes monthly penalty of five percent up to twenty-five percent for intentional failure to file reports or perform statutory duties.

headings.title: Civil penalty and class A misdemeanor for intentional failure to deliver property
headings.reviewNote: Imposes per-day penalty up to ten thousand dollars and class A misdemeanor for intentional refusal to pay or deliver abandoned property.

headings.title: Fine and class B misdemeanor for intentional false statements in reports
headings.reviewNote: Imposes fine between one hundred and ten thousand dollars and class B misdemeanor for intentional false statements in required reports.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 1998 H.B. 1510); verified monthly 5%-25% exclusive civil penalty, $100/day-$10,000 penalty and class A misdemeanor for refusal to deliver, and fine/class B misdemeanor for false statements.

headings.title: Written agreement and disclosure requirements for post-report property location
headings.reviewNote: Requires post-report property location agreements for compensation to be written, disclose nature and value, and be signed by owner.

headings.title: Time restrictions and graduated fee caps on property recovery agreements
headings.reviewNote: Renders recovery compensation agreements unenforceable within twelve months of payment or delivery to the treasurer and caps fees at 10%, 15%, and 20% over subsequent twelve-month intervals.

headings.title: Mandatory registration, good standing, and annual recertification for recovery agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires representative recovery agents to register, certify state regulatory and tax good standing, and recertify annually.

headings.title: Treasurer authority to require additional applicant registration information
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes treasurer to request additional information from registration applicants to protect property owners and citizens.

headings.title: Suspension of recovery agent registration, notice, hearing, and disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registration suspension for violations, written notice, chapter 536 hearing rights, and law enforcement referrals.

headings.title: Reregistration following registration suspension or lapse
headings.reviewNote: Permits persons whose registration was suspended or lapsed to seek reregistration under statutory requirements.

headings.title: Exemption for non-contingent representative discovery agreements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts fixed-fee, hourly, or daily non-contingent property-discovery agreements by any person (including personal representatives, guardians, trustees, and other representatives) from subsection 1, barring evasive arrangements.

headings.title: Owner right to assert excessive or unjust consideration
headings.reviewNote: Preserves owner right to challenge property location agreements at any time for excessive or unjust consideration.

headings.title: Infraction and class A misdemeanor penalties for unregistered recovery agreements
headings.reviewNote: Imposes infraction penalty and class A misdemeanor for repeat unregistered recovery representation, authorizing registration bans.

headings.title: Treasurer claim review, owner verification, and payment withholding
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes treasurer claim reviews, direct owner inquiries, and payment withholding pending verification of compliance and legitimacy.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2018 S.B. 644); refined subsections 2 and 7 reviewNotes for exact statutory scope and verified registration, suspension, graduated fee caps, infraction/misdemeanor penalties, and claim withholding.

headings.title: Reciprocal information sharing agreements with other states
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state treasurer to enter reciprocal agreements with other states to exchange abandoned property information.

headings.title: Enforcement actions brought by attorney general on behalf of reciprocal states
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri attorney general to sue in-state holders on behalf of reciprocal states meeting statutory criteria.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (7-01-94); verified reciprocal information-sharing agreements and four-part criteria for attorney general enforcement actions on behalf of other states.

headings.title: Conditions for recovery of escheated property by other states
headings.reviewNote: Sets conditions under which another state may recover escheated property, traveler's checks, money orders, or life insurance funds.

headings.title: Written presentation and processing of interstate recovery claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires other states to present claims in writing to the treasurer to be processed under section 447.562.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (7-01-94); verified three grounds for another state to recover escheated property and written claim processing under section 447.562.

headings.title: Safe deposit box fee retention and possessory lien enforcement by banking organizations
headings.reviewNote: Permits banking organizations to retain safe deposit box fees and enforce possessory liens when box contents become unclaimed property.

headings.title: Safe deposit box fee retention and possessory lien enforcement by financial organizations
headings.reviewNote: Permits financial organizations to retain safe deposit box fees and enforce possessory liens when box contents become unclaimed property.

headings.title: Safe deposit box fee retention and possessory lien enforcement by business associations
headings.reviewNote: Permits business associations to retain safe deposit box fees and enforce possessory liens when box contents become unclaimed property.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (7-01-94); verified parallel safe deposit box fee retention and possessory lien provisions for banking organizations, financial organizations, and business associations.

headings.title: Applicability to abandoned property petitions in home rule cities
headings.reviewNote: Applies section requirements to abandoned property rehabilitation petitions located within home rule cities.

headings.title: Issuance of summons and service of process in in rem actions
headings.reviewNote: Requires summons and service of process as in other in rem or quasi in rem civil actions.

headings.title: Required petition prayers for temporary possession and sheriff's deed
headings.reviewNote: Requires petition prayers for temporary possession for rehabilitation and for a sheriff's deed upon completion absent owner restoration.

headings.title: Mandatory stay of sheriff's deed ruling pending rehabilitation completion
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to stay ruling on prayer for sheriff's deed until property rehabilitation has been completed.

headings.title: Owner motion for restoration of possession prior to rehabilitation completion
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes property owner to move for restoration of possession and court determination of compensation prior to completion.

headings.title: Post-rehabilitation motion for sheriff's deed
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes organization to move for sheriff's deed in place of judicial deed upon completing rehabilitation.

headings.title: Conflict of laws and application of general rehabilitation statutes
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 447.620 to 447.640 except where in conflict with this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (through A.L. 2005 H.B. 58); verified all seven home-rule-city abandoned property rehabilitation petition, stay, restoration, and sheriff's deed subsections.

headings.title: Economic benefit projections and state financial assistance limits
headings.reviewNote: Limits total state funding, tax credits, and exemptions to projected state economic benefit as determined by department of economic development.

headings.title: Proportional repayment of assistance upon property sale within five years
headings.reviewNote: Requires partial repayment of tax credits and grants if property is sold within five years and achieves 25 percent IRR.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1998 S.B. 827); verified state economic benefit cap on project assistance and five-year sale repayment upon 25% annual internal rate of return.

headings.title: Property reuse fund direct loans and eligibility criteria
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes direct loans up to one million dollars from property reuse fund for economically sound eligible projects meeting job criteria.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of director determinations on loan agreements
headings.reviewNote: Makes director determinations conclusive as to the validity of signed loan agreements.

headings.title: Terms, security, and special consideration for voluntary remediation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to establish loan terms and security, giving special consideration to voluntary remediation actions.

headings.title: Director collection actions and deficiency enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of economic development to take actions necessary to collect on loans and deal with borrowers.

headings.title: Service charges for property reuse loan origination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to fix service charges for making property reuse loans.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and original-rolls footnote ('the' omitted in sub 5); verified $1M property reuse fund loan criteria, conclusive determinations, voluntary remediation consideration, collection, and service charges.

headings.title: Property reuse fund loan guarantees to private lenders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes loan guarantees to private lenders for up to one million dollars of allowable costs for eligible projects.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of director determinations on loan guarantee agreements
headings.reviewNote: Provides that director determinations are conclusive as to the validity of signed loan guarantee agreements.

headings.title: Loan guarantee interest rate limits and twenty-year maximum term
headings.reviewNote: Caps loan guarantee interest rates and prohibits underlying loan terms exceeding twenty years.

headings.title: Collection actions, guarantee regulations, and security valuation
headings.reviewNote: Directs enactment of regulations for guarantee payouts, default collections, and security valuation prior to payout.

headings.title: Service charges for loan guarantee origination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of economic development to fix service charges for making loan guarantees.

headings.title: Private lender liability immunity and guarantee payouts after foreclosure
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes private lenders from performance and environmental liability and mandates guarantee repayment after two-year holding.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1995 H.B. 414, A.L. 1998 S.B. 827); verified $1M loan guarantee criteria, prime+3% and 20-year limits, regulations, and private lender environmental immunity and two-year post-foreclosure payout.

headings.title: Public capital improvement grants to governmental agencies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes capital improvement grants up to one million dollars to governmental agencies for cooperative eligible projects meeting job thresholds.

headings.title: Conclusive effect of director determinations on grant agreements
headings.reviewNote: Provides that director determinations are conclusive as to the validity of signed grant agreements.

headings.title: Grant terms, disbursement, and voluntary remediation consideration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes grant terms and disbursements, directing special consideration for voluntary remediation project grants.

headings.title: Governmental agency administration and ban on hiring additional employees
headings.reviewNote: Directs recipient governmental agencies to administer public improvements and bars using grant funds to hire additional employees.

headings.title: Service charges for property reuse grant origination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of economic development to fix service charges for making property reuse grants.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and original-rolls footnotes ('government' in sub 1; 'the' omitted in sub 5); verified $1M cooperative public capital improvement grants and ban on hiring additional governmental employees.

headings.title: Enterprise zone tax credits and income exemptions for eligible projects
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes enterprise zone tax credits and income tax exemptions for facility operators meeting employment thresholds.

headings.title: Real property tax abatement approval by local government
headings.reviewNote: Preserves requirement for prospective purchasers to obtain local municipal or county approval for real property tax abatement.

headings.title: Remediation and demolition tax credits for voluntary cleanup
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remediation tax credits up to 100 percent of costs, non-remediation demolition credits, and staggered 75 percent issuance rules.

headings.title: Director discretion to terminate, suspend, or revoke tax benefits
headings.reviewNote: Permits director to terminate, suspend, or revoke tax benefits for condition violations and establishes appeal rights under section 135.250.

headings.title: Prohibition on claiming duplicate tax credits for same facility
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits taxpayers from claiming duplicate enterprise zone and new business facility credits for the same facility and tax period.

headings.title: Maximum percentage limits on eligible project tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Caps total allowable tax credits based on project-attributed income and statewide facility operations.

headings.title: Filing deadlines and forfeiture of business facility tax benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing credit applications during the period immediately after facility use and prohibits carryforward of unused credits.

headings.title: Filing deadlines for remediation tax credit applications
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing remediation credit applications in the tax period immediately following facility use or voluntary remediation completion.

headings.title: Assignment, sale, or transfer of remediation tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assignors to transfer remediation tax credits upon written notice, limiting assignee claims to twenty tax periods.

headings.title: Transfer of business facility tax benefits upon facility sale
headings.reviewNote: Permits assignees continuing operations to claim remaining business facility credits up to ten total tax periods.

headings.title: Apportionment of tax benefits to corporate shareholders and partners
headings.reviewNote: Apportions pass-through tax credits to S-corporation shareholders and partners based on ownership shares on last day of tax period.

headings.title: Demolition tax credits for former automobile manufacturing plants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remediation tax credits for demolition costs in qualifying charter counties for former auto plants creating 250 jobs.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text, section 3.060 renumbering footnote (H.B. 315, 2011), and Tax Credit Accountability Act cross-reference (135.800 to 135.830); verified all twelve enterprise zone, remediation, transfer, and auto-plant demolition credit subsections.

headings.title: Creation and funding of Property Reuse Revolving Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates Property Reuse Revolving Fund to provide ten million dollars annually for loans, guarantees, and grants, non-reverting to general revenue.

headings.title: Annual treasurer certification of fund balance to state agencies
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual certification of fund balance by state treasurer to economic development, natural resources, and revenue departments.

headings.title: Investment of fund balances and crediting of earnings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes treasurer investment of unneeded revolving fund balances with earnings credited back to the fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text and effective date (12-23-97); verified Property Reuse Revolving Fund creation, non-reversion under section 33.080, annual certification, and investment earnings.

headings.title: Definitions of harm and tort action
headings.reviewNote: Defines harm from hazardous substance or petroleum exposure and tort action for purposes of project liability immunity.

headings.title: Tort immunity for governmental agencies, personnel, and purchasers
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes governmental agencies, employees, and purchasers from tort liability arising out of eligible project performance until DNR completion approval.

headings.title: Exceptions to immunity for ultra vires, malicious, or reckless acts
headings.reviewNote: Excludes acts manifestly outside employment scope or committed maliciously, in bad faith, or recklessly from tort immunity.

headings.title: Environmental and tort protection for foreclosing governmental entities
headings.reviewNote: Protects governmental entities acquiring property by foreclosure from tort and environmental liability and extends creditor protections.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1995 H.B. 414); verified harm/tort definitions, agency/purchaser tort immunity until DNR approval, ultra vires/malicious exceptions, and foreclosing government environmental immunity.

headings.title: Release of purchaser liability upon completed voluntary remediation
headings.reviewNote: Releases purchasers from liability upon satisfactory completion of voluntary remediation activities approved by department of natural resources.

headings.title: No further action letters, covenants not to sue, and public hearing
headings.reviewNote: Directs DNR to issue no-further-action letters (after Phase I/II assessments or alternative-goal voluntary remediation) or covenants not to sue (below regulatory action levels after 30-day notice and community public hearing).

headings.title: Third-party civil immunity for cleanup and response costs
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes purchasers upon completing voluntary remediation from third-party civil actions for cleanup, response, or restitution costs, except for failure to follow the remediation plan or environmental laws.

headings.title: Exclusions from liability release for post-acquisition or unknown contamination
headings.reviewNote: Excludes unaddressed conditions, post-acquisition contamination, and unknown hazards from department liability release.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1995 H.B. 414); corrected subsections 2 and 3 titles and notes to reflect DNR no-further-action letters, covenants not to sue with 30-day public hearing, and third-party civil cleanup-cost immunity.

headings.title: Sanctions, repayment, and ten percent penalty for project breach
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a purchaser breaching a qualified project agreement or misusing funds may be responsible for immediate repayment with interest and a 10% penalty, and is ineligible for section 447.708 tax benefits and section 447.714 releases.

headings.title: Sanctions and penalties for failure to perform voluntary remediation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a purchaser failing to properly perform voluntary remediation to DNR satisfaction may be responsible for immediate repayment with interest and a 10% penalty, and is ineligible for section 447.708 tax benefits and section 447.714 releases.

headings.title: Withdrawal of loan guarantee and loss of tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes withdrawal of excess loan guarantees and terminates tax credits and liability releases upon violation.

headings.title: Termination of obligations upon bankruptcy or adverse business change
headings.reviewNote: Permits termination on ninety days' notice upon bankruptcy or insolvency, with loan repayment and partial releases at DNR discretion.

headings.title: Director determination of sanctions and local government consultation
headings.reviewNote: Directs economic development director to determine sanctions with DNR approval and consult affected local governments.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1995 H.B. 414); corrected subsections 1 and 2 reviewNotes to preserve permissive 'may be responsible' wording for repayment and 10% penalty alongside loss of credits and liability releases.

headings.title: Department of economic development rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department of economic development to promulgate administrative rules for the property reuse program.

headings.title: Joint committee on administrative rules approval requirement
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rule effectiveness and legislative delegation on joint committee on administrative rules review and approval.

headings.title: Concurrent submission of proposed rules and committee hearings
headings.reviewNote: Requires concurrent submission of proposed rules to joint committee and authorizes public committee hearings.

headings.title: Thirty-day committee review period before final filing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits filing final orders of rulemaking until thirty days after receipt by joint committee, deeming un-disapproved rules approved.

headings.title: Grounds for committee suspension of rulemaking orders
headings.reviewNote: Specifies exclusive statutory grounds for committee suspension of rulemaking orders prior to final filing.

headings.title: Prohibition on filing or publishing disapproved rules
headings.reviewNote: Bars department from filing and secretary of state from publishing disapproved portions of rulemaking orders.

headings.title: Legislative report and thirty-day ratification of disapproved rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires committee report to general assembly and thirty-day concurrent resolution ratification to prevent disapproved rules from taking effect.

headings.title: General assembly suspension or revocation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes general assembly to suspend or revoke promulgated rules by bill or constitutional concurrent resolution upon committee recommendation.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked complete archived text (L. 1995 H.B. 414); verified rulemaking authority and archived JCAR approval, 30-day review, suspension grounds, ratification, and general assembly revocation procedures.
